facts.business: Accelya Solutions India Limited is a technology partner to the airline industry, providing software solutions for revenue accounting, settlement, and financial management, including the FLX ONE platform and AI capabilities through FLX AIViator.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgment in identifying performance obligations, determining transaction prices, and assessing satisfaction of obligations over time, with inherent risk and presumed fraud risk due to customized and complex contracts.
facts.related_party_note: Revenue contracts with related parties where billing is done on cost plus markup basis as per contract terms.
